title: Elderly widow sees a ball of light at her kitchen window

tellings.quote: she said, "I saw this ball of light go by my kitchen window.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says strange lights and UFOs tend to appear around him, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast what an elderly widow told him. According to Bledsoe, she said she saw a ball of light go past her kitchen window. He tells it as one more sign that these lights show up to ordinary people near him, though no time or place is given.
